description: This file defines the NetworkReceive class, which handles size-delimited network data reception, including buffer management, reading from channels, and error handling within Kafka's networking module.

classes.name: NetworkReceive
classes.description: Handles size-delimited network data reception, buffer allocation, reading from channels, and resource management.

methods.name: source
methods.description: Returns the source identifier of the network receive instance.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Checks if the receive operation is complete (size and buffer are fully read).

methods.name: readFrom
methods.description: Reads data from a ScatteringByteChannel, managing size prefix and payload buffers, handling errors, and logging.

methods.name: requiredMemoryAmountKnown
methods.description: Indicates if the required memory size has been determined.

methods.name: memoryAllocated
methods.description: Checks if memory has been allocated for the payload buffer.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Releases allocated buffers back to the memory pool and cleans up resources.

methods.name: bytesRead
methods.description: Returns the total number of bytes read so far.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the total size of the receive including payload and size buffer.

methods.name: getMaxSize
methods.description: Determines the maximum buffer size based on input and predefined limits.
